ionic_covalent_confusion.feedback: Carbon compounds are covalent — they share electrons; most are poor conductors.
ionic_covalent_confusion.calm_prompt: Carbon shares electrons; it does not form ionic bonds with itself.

saturated_unsaturated_swap.feedback: Saturated = single C–C bonds (alkanes); unsaturated = double/triple bonds (alkenes/alkynes).
saturated_unsaturated_swap.calm_prompt: Unsaturated decolourises bromine water; saturated does not.

addition_substitution_confusion.feedback: Addition: unsaturated compounds gain atoms (e.g. ethene + H₂). Substitution: saturated compounds swap H for another group.

functional_group_naming_error.feedback: Name the longest carbon chain and identify the functional group (-OH alcohol, -COOH carboxylic acid).
functional_group_naming_error.calm_prompt: Functional group decides the suffix (-ol, -al, -oic acid).

soap_detergent_hard_water_error.feedback: Soap forms scum with hard water; detergents work in hard water too.
soap_detergent_hard_water_error.calm_prompt: Micelles trap oily dirt; hard water blocks soap with Ca/Mg salts.
